title: Original Articulated Traveler Studies
provenance: Original synthetic artwork created for Man of La Machina. No historical image was traced. The 1965 reference attachment was unavailable.
common_action: Two-second walking-in-place loop with opposite leg angles of approximately -14 and +14 degrees.

differences.native: Separate original drawing implemented in Landscape.jsx; same walking concept, not identical geometry.
differences.rive: 60 fps,120-frame loop; leg, arm, cloak, head rotations and body bob; cubic easing.
differences.lottie: 60 fps,120-frame duration; leg rotation keys only at frames0,60,119; linear interpolation.

assets.method: Original nine-part vector geometry, authored as polygons for this study. Static source imported into Lottie Creator.
Created in Rive desktop through its official MCP and exported through export_file inline_base64. Runtime file, not a .rev backup.
Original SVG imported into Lottie Creator; rotations keyed through its UI; standard JSON downloaded using the editor Export control.
Static Rive capture_artboard rendering of the original cutout; fallback poster, not a frame-accurate recording.
